messages:
lucy_sales: Heads-up: HelioMetrics signed the NDA and wants a short perf check next Friday. Scope: quick smoke, one sustained run, and two short microbursts plus a fallback routing exercise. Need a one-page run plan we can send them, hosted vs Dedicated ballpark, and a short KMS/audit blurb for their security questionnaire. Can someone take point? :wave:

mike_se: I can take it. From their sample traces: median input ~340 tokens, gen ~130. Proposed light plan: smoke 8m @ 12 qps, sustained 30m @ 100 qps (to stress batching), 2 microbursts 40s @ 260 qps spaced 3m. Also include a fallback test: when latency >750ms route 30% to redwood-compat-small. I'll produce a tiny python harness and a JMeter passthrough.

ani_ops: Ops notes: Dedicated pool gives best p99 stability for 260qps spikes. Hosted can do sustained 100 qps fine; microbursts require pre-warm (recommend 2x burst nodes) or short reserved capacity. Ops needs their IP allowlist and region preference. KMS + audit retention are add-ons; ops needs a named contact for key rotation.

noah_eng: Please include cold-path vs warm-path measures. Add header X-RW-KV-Cache: false for cold, X-RW-Warm: true for warm. Also enable rtail p50/p95/p99 and a 1% trace sample during the window. I'll monitor and collect token-level counts and tail traces.

mike_se: Sharing the curl example for buyer to run with the test key:

```
POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-xl-1.0","input":"Extract key points: <SAMPLE_DOC>","max_tokens":140}
```

Add `X-RW-KV-Cache: false` for cold and `X-RW-Warm: true` for warm. For fallback sim set header `X-RW-Fallback: redwood-compat-small`.

lucy_sales: Pricing note for buyer: assume ~150k gen tokens across the runs + 1 day follow-up. Can you give hosted per-token BEO and Dedicated day-rate? Also short KMS/audit note for their security team.

ani_ops: Quick BEO: hosted gen ~ $0.00040/token -> 150k ~= $60. Hosted run ops/support ~= $125. Dedicated small node day-rate ~= $480/day. KMS/audit setup ~= $500 one-time + $200/mo retention. SOC2 cert link will be attached separately.

noah_eng: I'll be on-call for the test window. If p99 goes >1.8s during bursts we scale an extra node. Enable token-level logs only for the window and ensure redaction is applied per contract.

deploy-bot: perf-harness v2.3 deployed to perf cluster by @deploy-bot

lucy_sales: Perfect. I'll send HelioMetrics the one-pager with the plan, pricing snapshot, and the checklist asking for IP ranges and their KMS contact. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
